name: set_init
declaration: unsafe fn set_init (& mut self , n : usize) -> & mut Self
documentation:
Asserts that the first `n` bytes of the buffer are initialized.

 `BorrowedBuf` assumes that bytes are never de-initialized, so this method does nothing when called with fewer
 bytes than are already known to be initialized.

 # Safety

 The caller must ensure that the first `n` unfilled bytes of the buffer have already been initialized.
rules: The caller must ensure that the first n unfilled bytes of the buffer have already been initialized.
